papers.title: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them
papers.summary: Rigorous optimizer benchmarking shows that vanilla Muon's efficiency advantage over AdamW shrinks with overtraining under constant weight decay.
papers.alt: Optimizer token efficiency at different overtraining budgets for 1.2B models

papers.title: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them II: Hyperball Optimization
papers.summary: Hyperball uses weight-normalized training to improve Muon's efficiency.
papers.alt: Hyperball update followed by normalization to a fixed weight norm

papers.title: Understanding Warmup-Stable-Decay Learning Rates: A River Valley Loss Landscape Perspective
papers.summary: Pretraining loss exhibits a river valley landscape, which resembles a deep valley with a river at its bottom. This explains how training with a high learning rate can make more progress than training with a low learning rate, even when its intermediate losses are higher.
papers.alt: River valley landscape and trajectories under different learning rates

papers.title: Trust the Critic More
papers.summary: A learned critic can guide reasoning RL using partial solutions. On Qwen3-4B trained on FineProofs-RL, AC2 exceeds GRPO's best mean score on IMO-ProofBench with approximately 60% fewer decoding FLOPs.
papers.alt: GRPO terminal rewards compared with AC2 critic estimates on partial solutions

papers.title: Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas?
papers.summary: Priced Guidance uses “20 Questions” to measure the amount of information an LLM needs to recover a future research idea. This yields a lower bound on the probability of generating that idea without hints.
papers.alt: Priced Guidance question-and-answer protocol for recovering a research idea
